title: Lisse stratum Hom reduction with exceptional Tor bounds
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and integers $n\ge m\ge1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$, $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^m)$ with the quotient map [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules over constant coefficient rings on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $F_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ on a scheme $T$, and $H_R(U,V)=R\mathcal Hom_R(U,V)$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}$ consists of complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude in some finite interval $[a,b]$: $\mathcal H^i(K\otimes_R^L W)=0$ for every degree-zero module sheaf $W$ and $i\notin[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Let $g:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be closed and $j:S\hookrightarrow Z$ open, set $s=gj$, $Rs_!=g_*j_!$ and $Rs_A^!=j^*Rg_A^!$, with $g_*\dashv Rg_A^!$ the etale closed-support adjunction [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, lem-exc-closed-ambient, def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $L$ be a locally constant sheaf of finite projective $A$-modules on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$, placed in degree zero: etale locally it is constant with value a finite projective $A$-module. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$. Choose nonnegative integers $d_X,d_S$ bounding $\dim X,\dim S$; the bound zero is allowed for an empty scheme. Then $L$ is etale locally finite free, is site-perfect in degree zero, and has Tor interval $[0,0]$. The object $N=Rs_A^!M$ is bounded constructible of Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d_X+1]$, and $Q=H_A(L,N)$ is bounded constructible of Tor amplitude in $[a-2d_S,b+2d_X+1+2d_S]$.

The evaluation-transpose comparison $u:Q\otimes_A^LB\to H_B(L\otimes_A^LB,N\otimes_A^LB)$ is an isomorphism in $D^b_{ctf}(S,B)$, with both endpoints in that category. More precisely, on every etale covering object trivializing $L$ as $A^t[0]$, $t\ge0$, and for a bounded flat model $P$ of $N$ restricted there, the canonical bounded-free Hom models identify $Q$ with $P^{\oplus t}$, the target with $(P\otimes_A B)^{\oplus t}$, and $u$ with the identity of $(P\otimes_A B)^{\oplus t}$. This identification is compatible with restriction, the $B$ action, and evaluation, including rank zero.
